title: Write the bounce guard's recovery window before resuming a paused campaign
hypothesis: A repaired campaign can be resumed directly.
change: Wrote the Togari recovery window baseline, then proved it with a one-lead simulation before resuming three campaigns.
result: Without the window the lifetime 3% rule pauses a repaired campaign on its next five-minute tick (Qube B sat at 2 bounces in 32 sends). With it, all three resumed and guard ticks read atRisk 0. Held enrollments also stay active while paused, so they were blocklisted first.
next_decision: Make the window part of the resume op so it can't be skipped.
check: Before a resume: blocklist held enrollments, write the recovery window, simulate one bounce and one clean send, then resume.
scope: Campaigns watched by Togari's bounce guard.
